dishes.name: Möppkenbrot
dishes.desc: Buckwheat blood loaf sliced and fried until crisp, served with apple sauce or bread. A Münsterland winter dish.

dishes.name: Stielmus with Mettwurst
dishes.desc: Stewed turnip greens with potatoes and smoked Mettwurst, a seasonal Münsterland farm dish.

dishes.name: Pannekoken
dishes.desc: Thick pancake served with bacon or apple, a Dutch-influenced Münsterland dish.

dishes.name: Münsterland wedding soup
dishes.desc: Clear beef soup with meatballs, vegetables and egg custard, traditionally served at farm weddings in the Münsterland.
